dct_title_s: Map #11; Sectional Map of Lake County Minnesota Compiled from Government Surveys and County Records
dct_description_sm: Topographic map of the Lake County region featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink and colored pencil possibly regarding the location railroads and of logging camps in the area north of Finland.
